CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION law.reject_audit_mutation()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
  RAISE EXCEPTION '审计日志只允许追加' USING ERRCODE = '23514';
END;
$function$
